mintAuthority.summary: cdxUSD uses a GHO-style facilitator bucket model on Base. The active 3/9 Safe facilitator mints within a finite bucket. The owner contract is a TimelockController (24h delay) with the 3/9 Safe as PROPOSER and 1/8 guardian Safe as EXECUTOR. The OFT LayerZero extension is present in code but has zero configured peers — no cross-chain mint surface active.

controls.label: cdxUSD active facilitator Safe
controls.capDescription: getFacilitator returned bucket capacity 100000000000000000000000000 and bucket level 6150000000000000000000000 at Base block 46426970.

routeChecks.caps: Finite facilitator bucket capacity read from getFacilitator/getFacilitatorBucket.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Token exposes hourlyLimit/slidingHourlyLimitUtilization; hourlyLimit read returned 0 in this pass.

controls.evidence: getFacilitatorsList returned this address; getFacilitator returned label Multisig and a finite bucket. Base Safe API returned threshold 3, 9 owners, no modules, and zero guard.

controls.label: cdxUSD owner TimelockController (24h delay)
controls.evidence: Base blockscout confirms contract name TimelockController (OZ, solc 0.8.23). getMinDelay() returned 86400 (24h). hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, 3/9 facilitator Safe) = true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 1/8 guardian Safe) = true; hasRole(TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, self) = false; 0 RoleGranted events emitted (roles set at deploy-time via constructor args, no enumerable log trail). No active admin can bypass the 24h delay.

controls.label: cdxUSD guardian Safe (Timelock executor)
controls.evidence: guardian() returned this address; Base Safe API returned threshold 1, 8 owners, no modules, zero guard. hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE) confirmed true on Timelock.

review.evidence: Base block 47201791: facilitator bucket confirmed (3/9 Safe, finite cap); owner contract confirmed as OZ TimelockController with 24h delay; 3/9 Safe is PROPOSER, 1/8 guardian is EXECUTOR; no admin bypass. LayerZero OFT code present but 0 SetPeer events ever emitted and 0 total token Transfer events (token has supply of 6.15M from prior facilitator mints, minimal activity on-chain). Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the finite facilitator bucket is raiseable only through the enforced 24-hour timelock, but no repo evidence reconciles facilitator collateral to the whole supply and no supervisor or attestor is identified.
